name: NyxBot Voice
description: Realtime voice for a specific personal Bot. The owner explicitly creates a separate voice connection for each Bot in Agent details, then grants that UserService to an Agent Key. A generic catalog connection authorizes no Bot. Each Bot retains its existing grants, confirmations, private conversation history and billing. Keys with all-services access include published connections under the existing policy.
auth_notes: Requires an ordinary NyxID Agent Key with proxy scope and access to the server-bound voice connection of the selected Bot. Forward the original caller Agent Key as Authorization: Bearer. Creating a connection grants no Key explicitly. A catalog ID or an unbound generic connection is insufficient. No owner session, separate device voice token or provider credential is distributed.
known_limitations: Personal owned Bots only. Per-Bot connections are explicitly created through Agent details; connecting this catalog template directly does not bind a Bot. Operation-scoped Keys cannot open voice WebSockets under existing B1 policy. Existing service approval policy must already allow each operation. Provider availability, account voice settings, balances and confirmations still apply.
